max_limits_reached.meaning: the order book side has reached maxNumLimitsPerSide, the threshold at which non-competitive orders should be removed upon adding new orders

worst_queue_multiple_orders.meaning: the worst price limit queue contains more than one order

new_order_new_limit.meaning: the new order being added introduces a new limit/price queue

least_competitive_removed.meaning: the least competitive price order is removed from the order book

assumptions: The least competitive price order removal is the invariant whose preservation is required when maxNumLimitsPerSide is reached and a new limit is introduced.
The worst price limit queue containing more than one order is the configuration in which the removal must still occur.

unresolved.description: Report does not give the numeric value of maxNumLimitsPerSide or the resulting tree size, so the size threshold is represented only by the grounded Boolean max_limits_reached.

Report does not define the concrete invariant predicate beyond 'a significant protocol invariant that should hold is broken'; the invariant is represented as the grounded Boolean least_competitive_removed.

limitations: The invariant is formalized as the removal of the least competitive price order; the specific invariant content is not numerically defined in the report.

The removal obligation is tied to the maxNumLimitsPerSide-reached and new-limit conditions stated in the intent; the multi-order worst queue is treated as an assumption rather than part of the obligation condition.
